description: Unbroken helps busy professionals track five daily life pillars with five taps, turning consistency into a habit even after a missed day.

landing.headline: One missed day won't break you.
landing.subheadline: Unbroken is for busy professionals who want balanced habits — check off Work, Fitness, Nutrition, Sleep, and Health in under ten seconds a day.

features.title: Five-Pillar Check-In
features.description: Tap yes or no for each of your five pillars and your whole day is logged before your coffee goes cold.

features.title: Streak Per Pillar
features.description: See your current run for each pillar separately, so a rough sleep night never wipes out your fitness streak.

features.title: 30-Day Calendar Grid
features.description: Scan a colour-coded monthly grid to see the full picture of your consistency rather than fixating on a single missed day.

features.title: Longest-Streak Badge
features.description: Your personal best for each pillar stays on display even after a reset, reminding you what you are capable of.
